title: Source-Account Delta Agents
summary: Implementation is active. Exact Gmail/Slack account assignments use sealed provider-to-model delta handoffs, wake immediately from source ingress, and cost zero model calls on empty deltas. Production proves all three token-backed accounts are independently advancing. Ordinary Chief cycles now coordinate persisted results without repeating Gmail/Slack acquisition, while bounded deep reconciliation remains available.
next_action: Deploy the persisted-results Chief cutover, then confirm account cursors, assignments, and exact runtime health remain clean in production.

verification.notes: Plain spectacula invocation sets final_vetting off. Development and test compilation with warnings-as-errors pass; source-account discovery, closure, completion, and periodic tests pass, including the sealed no-Chief discovery handoff. Gmail advisor passes 22/22, Gmail ingress handler passes 4/4, exact Gmail/Slack ingress wake tests pass, and the touched AI Chief suite passes 26/26 with persisted-results and explicit deep-reconciliation coverage. Production exact-runtime diagnosis is clean at 64 ready partitions with no draining, blocked, unassigned, or unsettled task assignments. Production account telemetry shows two fresh Gmail discovery cursors, one fresh Slack discovery cursor, seven retry-free provider acquisitions, five completed model handoffs, and one normally running handoff at snapshot time. Broad suites remain intentionally skipped under repository policy.
